recentlyPlayedWith.empty: You haven't played with anyone on this device yet. Start playing to see your recent opponents here!

awaitingPurchaseConfirmation.title: Awaiting Purchase Confirmation
awaitingPurchaseConfirmation.description: This typically takes just a few seconds. Depending on your payment method this may take longer. Feel free to close this screen.

friend.noAccount: Login or create an account to start making friends!
friend.description: Stay connected! See your friends online, their games, and join their private lobbies!
friend.removeDescription: You are about to end your friendship with "{name}".
friend.inviteSent: The game invite has been sent!
friend.friends: You are friends with this user.

info.contact: Don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or have any questions! You can get in touch by sending an email or by joining the Bloob.io Discord.

redeemCode.title: Redeem Code
redeemCode.description: Enter a unique code below to unlock special items for even more customization. Each code can only be used once.
redeemCode.unlinked: In order to redeem a code you must first log in or create an account.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Experience (XP) is awarded at the end of a match. Reaching certain XP thresholds will level you up and help you unlock new titles.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: Statistics are tracked per game and match. They can give you or others insights in how well you are performing.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Bloob.io anonymously tracks analytics using a privacy-friendly, self-hosted analytics server. Your data is never shared with others. You may opt out if you wish.
analytics.blocked: Analytics are not active. Your browser or extension may have blocked it.
analytics.dnt: Your browser has the "Do Not Track" (DNT) setting enabled. We honor your request and are not tracking you.

ads.title: Ads
ads.description: We display advertisements from {provider}. The advertising on Bloob.io, whether in full or in part, is handled by {provider}. If you do not want to see ads on Bloob.io, you can go ad-free by purchasing coins from the store. This will automatically remove all ads for your account.
ads.complaint: It is important to Bloob.io that the ads you see are ethical and non intrusive. If you notice ads that interfere with your gameplay please reach out by checking the "About" section.
ads.consent: Click here to update your ad consent preferences
ads.exempt: Ads are not active. Your account is ad-free. Thank you for your support!
ads.blocked: Ads are not active. Your browser or extension may have blocked it.

serverData.title: Server Data
serverData.description: You can see all your stored data on Bloob.io below. Sensitive info like an email address and secret keys may be hidden for your security.

controlYourData.title: Control Your Data
controlYourData.description: You are always in full control of your data on Bloob.io. Bloob.io can be played anonymously. In the event you do want to delete your data you can do so here. If you have an account you will first need to unlink your email and come back here.
controlYourData.descriptionSocialLink: Your account is linked to another platform ({social}) and your data can be controlled there.

localStorage.title: Local Storage
localStorage.description: Browser data (e.g. language, volume settings) is stored in your browser's 'localStorage', not on our server.

myDevices.description: View and control which devices you are logged in on. You are also able to rename your current device for your convenience.
myDevices.noOtherDevices: No other devices are logged in. Did you know you can switch between devices in the middle of any game?
myDevices.unlinked: You have not yet created an account or logged in and your user can only be accessed on this device.

login.title: Login
login.description: Heads up! The current user you are using, {name} which is {level}, is not yet attached to an account. Logging in with an existing account will permanently delete this user. Maybe you meant to create your account instead?

setupThreshold.title: You're early {name}!
setupThreshold.description: You must be {level} or higher to make an account. You are {percentage} on your way there!

setup.title: Hi, {name}!
setup.description: Create an account with just your email address to keep your progress safe and synced across all your devices. No password needed!
setup.disclaimer: We only use your email address to verify your account and log you in. Remove your email address anytime.

unlink.title: Remove Email Address
unlink.description: You are about to remove your email address from your {name} account. Your progress will no longer be synchronized and you will only be able to access your user on this device.

unlinkSuccess.title: Email Address Removed
unlinkSuccess.description: Your email address has been removed from your account. This user can now only be accessed on this device.

transferStart.title: Update Your Email Address
transferStart.description: To change the email address linked to {name}, please verify the current email address below. Once verified, you can enter the new email address.

transferConfirm.title: New Email Address
transferConfirm.description: Great news {name}! Your current email address has been verified successfully. To complete the process, please provide your new email address below.

transferSuccess.title: Email Address Changed
transferSuccess.description: The email address linked to your account has been changed. For your security, you have been logged out on all other devices and will need to login again with your new email address.

logout.title: Logout
logout.description: As you have an account, your progress will be saved and can be retrieved by logging back in with your email address.

logoutGlobally.title: Logout Everywhere
logoutGlobally.description: This will log your account out of all devices including this one.

logoutSuccess.title: Logged Out
logoutSuccess.description: Your account has been logged out on this device. You can log back in using your email address.

relogin.title: Welcome back, {name}!
relogin.description: You were logged out. Use your email address to gain access again.

ready.title: You're all set, {name}!
ready.description: Your progress is now saved and synchronized!

authentication.loginNoAccount: Login with your email address below to access your account on this device.
authentication.logoutGloballyCompleted: Your account has been logged out from all devices.
authentication.verificationEmail: An email with a verification code has been sent.
authentication.noEmail: No email? Check your spam folder and confirm this email address is linked to your account.

characterDownload.title: Character Picture Download
characterDownload.description: Download a high-resolution image of your Bloob.io character. Use it as a profile picture on Discord or any other platform.

connection.title: You are unable to connect to the game server.

content.clientOffline: It looks like you are offline. Please check your internet connection.
content.serverMaintenance: The game server is currently undergoing maintenance to improve your experience. Check back soon!
content.serverOffline: It appears the game server is unexpectedly offline. Please check the status page for updates. We're working on getting things back online!
content.serverUnavailable: We were unable to check the server status. You can try checking the status manually instead.
content.clientRestrictedNetwork: It seems you're on a restricted network (like at school or work), which may affect your connection. Try using a VPN or switch to mobile data.
content.clientChangingNetwork: It looks like you switched networks. We detected at least {networkCount} network changes. This can happen due to toggling mobile data, changing VPN locations, or moving between Wi-Fi networks. To maintain a stable connection, please stick to a single network.
content.clientFrequentlyOffline: Your connection appears to be unstable. We detected that your network has gone offline at least {offlineCount} times. Consider toggling your mobile data, VPN, or switching to a different network.
content.clientFrequentlyReconnected: Your connection to the server seems to be unstable. Your ping is {ping}ms and you have {reconnectedCount} reconnect attempts. If possible, try changing your network connection by turning on/off your mobile data or VPN.
content.unknown: Everything seems to be fine, try refreshing the window. Keep seeing this page? Please reach out!

statLimit.SOLO: Some statistics are not tracked in solo play, including wins, losses, and win streaks.
statLimit.LOCAL_PLAY: Some statistics are not tracked in local multiplayer, including wins, losses, and win streaks.
statLimit.SETTINGS: Some statistics are not tracked when playing with modified settings, wins, losses, win streaks, and high scores for example.

graphicsAcceleration.notice: Graphics acceleration is disabled. This may impact game performance.

accountWarning.title: Account Warning
accountWarning.description: You have received an official account warning. Multiple warnings will result in more severe punishments.

reason.BAD_NAME: Your (previous) username "{content}" contains a slur, profanity, or other inappropriate language.
reason.GAME_QUIT: You have shown unsportsmanlike behavior in previous games by leaving before finishing the match.
reason.TOXIC_CHAT: You have displayed toxic behavior with your use of chat in previous games.

punishment.NAME_BLOCKED: You are blocked from changing your username
punishment.CHAT_BLOCKED: You are blocked from using the in-game chat
punishment.MATCHMAKING_BLOCKED: You are blocked from matchmaking and public lobbies

about.description: Bloob.io is a project of passion consisting of multiplayer browser games. Suggestions are always welcome!
about.licensing: Some games can be licensed for use on your site or platform (with custom adjustments). Get in touch in case you are interested.

info.skipStepOverHalf: This step can also be skipped if over half the users vote to.
